tips: FLUX prefers full sentences over (tag:1.2) weighting.
If face is too smooth: add 'visible skin texture, subtle pores, natural makeup'.
If too dark: add 'high-key lighting, bright airy room'.
If hands fail: simplify pose, lower guidance to 3.0, or img2img the hands region.
Avoid extreme contortion wording — it causes extra limbs. Anchor pose with elbows/knees explicitly.
Fix a seed when you find a good face, then only change costume/background sentences.
